Read Only does not keep the app's command tool off the internet.

description: On the Mac desktop app, paint the left panel in the scheme's colour instead of see-through. Stock keeps the app's own look.

label: Custom scheme
description: For advanced use: JSON with "label", "dark" and "light" maps of colour names (e.g. "--dsw-alias-bg-base") to colours. Names you leave out keep the app's value.

label: Save custom scheme
description: Checks the custom scheme JSON and saves it; an invalid one is not saved.

label: 30 days
description: Period of the counts shown: 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or Year.

label: Refresh
description: Reads the usage counts again now. The page also refreshes every 15 seconds while it is open.

label: Usage counting on/off
description: Counts model requests and tokens per day and model. Only numbers are stored. Default on.

label: Keep counts for
description: How many days of counts are kept, 1 to 3650. Default 365.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /usage command (/usage reset clears every count). Default usage.

label: Agent swarm on/off
description: Switches the Agent swarm add-on and its run_swarm tool on or off. Default on.

label: Swarms
description: Named swarms: description, strategy (fanout, pipeline or debate), rounds, maxActive, maxMinutes, budget and members. This page only lists them.

label: Model prices
description: Dollars per million tokens sent and received, for each model, used for the dollar figures and budgets. Models not listed count as 0.

label: Benchmark on/off
description: Switches the Benchmark add-on, its jobs and the /benchmark command on or off. Default on.

label: Seeds needed for a confident pick
description: A recommendation with fewer seeds than this is marked low confidence and left out of the export, 1 to 50. Default 3.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /benchmark command. Default benchmark.

label: Data folder
description: Where code maps are kept. Empty uses a folder in the app's data folder.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /codemap command. Empty registers no command.

label: Reverse-engineer skills on/off
description: Registers the four reverse-engineer skills (/reverse-codebase, /reverse-website, /reverse-api-format, /reverse-app-binary). Default on.

label: Set up Python for Data
description: The first time Data is switched on, set up Plus's private Python for statistics and charts (about 450 MB). Off leaves data_python not set up.

label: Answer length limit
description: How much longer answers may get before a change is refused; 1.5 means 50% more tokens. 1 to 10, default 1.5.

label: Kind of subject
description: Company, sector, economy or market. Chosen with the drop-down on the Finance mode's start page; the last choice is saved here.

label: Subject
description: The company, sector or economy to research; may be empty. Typed on the Finance mode's start page.

label: Market
description: The market to research. Chosen on the Finance mode's start page. Default Global.

label: Focus
description: What the research concentrates on. Chosen on the Finance mode's start page. Default full.

label: Period
description: How far back to look. Chosen on the Finance mode's start page. Default year.

label: Data folder
description: Where the learning record is kept. Default a folder in the dsh home.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /learn command. Empty registers no command.

label: Rescan every N minutes
description: How often the Library folders are checked for new and changed files, in minutes. 0 checks only when asked. Default 10.

label: Arena on/off
description: Switches the Model arena and its /arena command on or off. Default on.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /arena command. Default arena.

label: Model profiles
description: Per-model sampling defaults as JSON keyed by provider and model id: label, wireEffort, temperature, maxTokens, enabled. Only a backup import changes it.

label: Model registry migrated
description: A one-time marker the app sets after moving model settings to the newer list. Not meant to be changed.

label: Starters migrated
description: One-time marker: installs from before 0.10 keep their starter names and model defaults. Not meant to be changed.

label: Profile per thread
description: Per-thread tier profile choice as JSON, set from the model button in the chat box. Without one, the project's default profile applies.

label: Clean up old thread entries
description: Once per start, drop per-thread tier and profile entries whose thread no longer exists. Default on.

label: Modes added by other add-ons
description: Modes other add-ons add (Finance, Research and others) as JSON in the modes format. Each add-on writes and removes its own entry.

heading: New threads
label: Mode for automations
description: A thread that an automation opens starts in this mode, whatever space the window shows. Automations made with the clock button or New open their threads in their own mode instead, while Alerts → New threads use the automation's mode is on. Saves at once. Default Cowork.

heading: Spaces
label: Preset in this space
description: For each space, which of the app's presets a new thread starts in: Any, Standard only or Creator only (the former Preset in this tab, with the same values). Defaults: Standard only for Recon and Devices, Creator only for Workshop, Any for Chat and Code; the Automations mode keeps its own Standard lock under Preset for one mode. Loosening a default asks first. Saves at once.

label: Mode per thread
description: Each thread's chosen mode as JSON, written by the mode selector in the chat box.

label: Sealed threads
description: Threads that began in a sealed mode; they stay sealed whatever happens to the mode. Written by the app.

label: Clean up old thread entries
description: Once per start, drop per-thread entries whose thread is no longer stored. Default on.

label: Keep a thread's first mode
description: Record the mode a thread starts in, so a later change of the default mode only affects new ones. Default on.

label: Web switch per thread
description: Each thread's Web On or Off as JSON, set with the Web button in the chat box. Missing uses the mode's default. How much it searches is its Depth.

label: Deep research per thread
description: Obsolete: the old per-thread Deep research switch. No longer offered or read; kept only so older settings files still load.

label: Web level per thread (obsolete)
description: Obsolete since 0.59.0: each thread's former Web level, moved into its Depth once (Deep became Thorough). The Web button is now only On or Off.

label: Depth per thread
description: Each thread's Depth (quick, standard or thorough; missing follows Depth for new threads) as JSON, set with the Depth button in the chat box, the same in every mode: how much it searches when Web is on, helpers, planning, checks and reviews, and the size of a research run.

label: Mission chosen per thread
description: Threads whose Depth is on Mission (chosen, not started) as JSON: Start Mission is the main-looking button there; Send keeps the thread's own Depth.

label: Lens per thread
description: Each thread's Lens (blunt, scientific, journalistic, data-only, skeptic or encouraging; missing is Default, which adds nothing): how the answer is worded. Not for helpers; paused during a study thread.

heading: Your own Lenses
label: Your own Lenses
description: Lenses you write yourself, shown in the chat box's Depth list after the six that come with Plus: at most 40, names up to 40 characters, texts up to 4,000, no name of a shipped Lens. Each gets the same closing lines as every Lens.

label: Web levels moved into Depth
description: One-time marker (0.59.0): each thread's former Web level was moved into its Depth. Not meant to be changed.

label: Space per thread
description: Each thread's space (Chat, Code, Devices, Recon or Workshop) as JSON, recorded at its first message in the space it was opened in (Move to changes it). Written by the app; the left panel lists threads by it.

label: Mode changes per thread
description: The mode changes made after a thread's first message, as JSON, for the quiet line in the thread ("Mode changed to Research"). Written by the app.

label: Guest automations kept in their space
description: The automations made from a guest thread in Devices or Workshop that open new threads, as JSON, with the space their runs must stay in. A run nobody placed there is held. Written by the app.

label: Modes of guest automations
description: The mode each Devices or Workshop automation was made in, so its held run names it. Kept by Modes; not something to edit.

heading: Modes and their spaces
label: Modes and their spaces
description: Every mode, an add-on's included, with five ticks: Chat, Code, Devices, Recon and Workshop. A ticked mode is offered in that space's Mode list under the chat box. A mode used in Devices, Recon or Workshop runs under the rules of that space; a tick there is greyed while what the space needs is off or too old. Saves at once.

heading: Modes and their spaces
label: Mode description
description: One line under a mode's name in the chat box's Mode list, for any mode, an add-on's included (its instructions stay the add-on's). Empty: the usual line. The pencil beside each mode, or the Description field of your own mode's card.

heading: Modes and their spaces
label: Extra tools a mode keeps in Recon
description: None by default. Only your Library can be added (search and read). Warning: what these tools read can end up in Recon's web searches. Applies from each thread's next message.

heading: Modes and their spaces
label: Tool access Off also applies in Devices and Workshop
description: On by default: what you switch Off for a mode in Tool access stays off when the mode is used in Devices or Workshop. Switch it off to let the space's own rules alone decide there. What Tool access switches On never applies there.

heading: Spaces
label: Shown, and the mode new threads start in
description: For each space: whether its button shows at the top of the left panel (Chat always shows; a hidden space's threads stay reachable through Show all and ⌘K search), and the mode a new thread there starts in. Saves at once.

label: Spaces given to existing threads
description: One-time marker: each existing thread was given the space of its mode. Not meant to be changed.

label: Threads placed when spaces went live
description: One-time marker: when the space buttons replaced the tabs, each thread was placed in the space where the tabs last put it. Not meant to be changed.

label: Tools switch per thread
description: Threads whose tools are switched off, as JSON, set with the Tools button in the chat box. While off, no tool is offered.

heading: New threads
label: Depth for new threads (and those that never picked one)
description: Where the Depth button starts in a new thread, in every mode (Research, Scout and Recon included): Quick, Standard or Thorough. A thread that never had a Depth picked follows it too. Picking a Depth in the chat box sets it too. Default Standard. It also sizes a research run (about 10, 25 or 45 minutes). (The former Web level Deep is Thorough.)

heading: Built-in working methods
label: Code: Plus's working method
description: Used while the Code mode's prompt is empty: read first, make small changes, run the tests, report plainly. Default on. Saves at once.

label: Helper models per thread
description: Each thread's choice of models for helper agents (same or roles) as JSON, set in the chat box. Without one, the choice on the Research page applies.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the slash command that switches modes. Default mode.

label: Tool families per thread
description: Tool families a thread has loaded (for example pdf, data), as JSON. Written by the app.

label: Old Search-off marks cleared
description: One-time marker (0.55.1): old Search off marks were cleared where Web Off would block a mode's own search tools. Not meant to be changed.

label: New threads
description: Where a new thread starts: its Depth, and the mode of threads that automations open. These save at once.

label: Sidebar
description: How many modes got a tab in the old tab layout of the left panel. Kept for that layout; the space buttons replace it.

heading: Left panel
label: Tabs in the left panel
description: Retired with the space buttons (item 4A): shown or hidden per space on Settings → Spaces replaces it. The value is kept for the old tab layout.

label: Built-in working methods
description: Plus's working methods for Code and Cowork, used while that mode's prompt is empty. These save at once.

heading: Built-in working methods
label: Cowork: Plus's working method
description: Used while the Cowork mode's prompt is empty: understand the task, keep a step list, ask before changing your files, check the result, report plainly. Default on. Saves at once.

heading: Plain chat's folder
label: Keep Plain chat inside its folder
description: A standalone Plain chat thread reads, writes, searches and runs commands only in its own folder; a project thread only in its project folder. Default on. Off: the app's file sandbox only, so a standalone thread can read anywhere and change other threads' Scratch folders. Saves at once.

label: Earlier access level per thread
description: Each thread's access level from before a mode changed it, and the mode its level was last set for, as JSON: leaving the mode puts the level back, also after a restart, and a thread moved to another mode while it was closed gets that mode's level when it is opened. Written by the app; kept on each Mac.

label: Data added to Load tools as needed
description: One-time marker (0.57.0): data was added to a stored Load tools as needed list. Not meant to be changed.

label: Plain chat given Cowork's choices
description: One-time marker (item 4A): Plain chat, the new start mode of the Chat space, was given the Cowork mode's Load tools as needed, skills switched off and Tool access choices. Not meant to be changed.

label: Plain chat given Cowork's other choices
description: One-time marker (item 4A, fix round 2): Plain chat was also given the Cowork mode's starting values, Mission tools, Mission's work loop choice and the other add-ons' per-mode choices where Cowork had them. The old keys stay. Not meant to be changed.

label: Plain chat given other add-ons' Cowork choices
description: One-time marker per add-on (item 4A, final fix round): the add-ons (Mission, Sampling presets, Agent swarm) whose Cowork per-mode choices Plain chat already took. An add-on installed later is carried once. Not meant to be changed.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /pdf command. Empty registers no command.

label: tor program path
description: Where the tor program is. Empty looks in the usual places (Homebrew, /usr/local). Plus does not install it.

label: Use another .onion search engine
description: Search with another .onion engine instead of the built-in filtered index (Ahmia). The blocklist and word screen apply either way. Default off.

label: Other engine address
description: That engine's .onion name (56 characters and .onion). Used only while the other engine is on.

label: Export folder
description: Where /recon export writes its files. Empty uses recon/exports in the app's home.

label: Old news server
description: The single news server of older versions. Read only to turn it into the first Usenet account.

label: Old news server port
description: That older news server's port, default 563. Read only to turn it into the first Usenet account.

label: Reports folder
description: Where Research reports are saved. Empty uses research/reports in the app's home.

label: Sampling presets on/off
description: Switches the Sampling presets add-on and its command on or off. Default on.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the /sampling command. Default sampling.

label: Job title or kind of work
description: The work to look for, in your words. Typed on the Scout mode's start page; saved here.

label: Location
description: Town, region or remote. Typed on the Scout mode's start page.

label: Pay target
description: The pay you aim for, as you write it. Typed on the Scout mode's start page.

label: Work type
description: Any, employee, freelance, contract, internship or tender. Chosen on the Scout mode's start page. Default any.

label: Scout folder
description: Folder for your files and the saved reports. Empty uses scout/files in the app's home.

label: Context Saver on/off
description: Shortens large tool results before the model sees them and keeps the originals. Off by default; needs the Python and data folder settings when on.

label: Python interpreter
description: Path of the Python that has dsh-intel-mcp installed. Required when Context Saver is on.

label: Data folder
description: Absolute folder where originals are kept; must equal DSH_INTEL_HOME of the context MCP server. Required when on.

label: Smallest result to shorten
description: Tool results shorter than this many characters are left alone, 500 to 1,000,000. Default 4000.

label: Least saving to keep
description: A shortened result is used only if it is at least this many percent smaller, 1 to 95. Default 15.

label: Tiers to compress
description: Tier ids set to true; when any are listed, only those tiers are compressed (needs Model tiers). Empty compresses every tier.

label: Tools never shortened
description: Tool names whose results stay verbatim. Default: the file read, write and edit tools, present and ask_user_question.

label: Retrieve tool name
description: Tool the model uses to get an original back; named in the prompt and never compressed. Default mcp__context__context_retrieve.

label: Helper timeout
description: Milliseconds the Python helper may take to shorten a result, 500 to 120000. Default 10000.

label: Prompt note
description: Adds a short system prompt section that explains shortened results and how to retrieve the full text. Default on.

label: Slash command name
description: Name of the command that shows tokens saved today and over 30 days. Default saved.

label: Model router on/off
description: Routes each turn to one of 2 to 5 candidate models using a small routing model. Default on.

label: Candidate models
description: 2 to 5 candidates, each a Tier id or a provider and model, with strengths saying what it is good at. Nothing is preset.

label: Routing model provider
description: Provider route of the small model that picks a candidate for each turn.

label: Routing model
description: Model id of the small routing model.

label: Routing timeout
description: Milliseconds to wait for the routing model; without an answer the current route is kept. 500 to 60000, default 4000.

label: Routing answer length
description: Most tokens the routing model may answer with, 50 to 2000. Default 200.

label: Turns to stay after a switch
description: Turns to stay on a candidate after switching to it, 0 to 50. Default 2. Each switch can discard the server's cache.

label: Minimum confidence
description: A routing answer below this confidence (0 to 1) is ignored. Default 0.6.

label: Default candidate
description: Candidate id to use when the routing answer cannot be used. Empty keeps the current one.

label: Respect route health
description: Leave out candidates whose route the Route health add-on reports as down. Default on.

label: Routing instructions
description: Extra text added to the routing model's instructions. Empty uses only the built-in text.

label: Recent messages shown
description: How many recent messages the routing model sees, 0 to 10. Default 3.

label: Routes to check
description: Per provider route: probeUrl, label, timeoutMs, slowMs, failureThreshold, reprobeSeconds, intervalSeconds. Nothing is checked until routes are listed.

label: Move off a down route
description: When a route goes down, move its threads to the next route in the tier's fallback chain. Default on.

label: Move back when it recovers
description: Move threads back to their own route once it is up again. Default on.

label: Only check routes in use
description: Probe a route only when a live thread or a tier uses it. Default on.

label: Refuse steps on a down route
description: Refuse a step on a down route with a clear error instead of letting it hang. Default on.

label: Media tools on/off
description: Switches the image tools and the approval gate for browser and computer-use tools on or off. Default on.

label: Image API address
description: Base URL of the images API, ending in /v1. Set it together with the image model.

label: Image model
description: Model id the image generate and edit tools use.

label: API key variable
description: Name of the environment variable that holds the image API key: a name, never the key. Leave out for a keyless server.

label: Image service name
description: Name of the image service shown in error messages. Optional.

label: Ask before image calls
description: When to ask before an image call: first (the first time), every time, or never. Default first.

label: Image calls per thread
description: Most image calls in one thread, 1 to 200. Default 20.

label: Images per request
description: Most images one generate call may make, 1 to 4. Default 4.

label: Image output folder
description: Folder inside the working folder where images are saved; must be relative. Default generated-images.

label: Accept image links
description: Accept an image URL from the API and download it (public addresses only). Off refuses URL results. Default on.

label: Image timeout
description: Milliseconds an image call may take, 1000 to 1800000. Default 180000.

label: Generate tool name
description: Name of the image generation tool. Default generate_image.

label: Edit tool name
description: Name of the image editing tool. Default edit_image.

label: Tools that need approval
description: Regular expressions of tool names (for example browser or computer-use tools) to ask about before they run.

label: Gate asks
description: Ask the first time a matching tool runs, or every time. Default first.

label: Gate question text
description: Text shown in the approval question. Optional.

label: OpenCode program path
description: Where the OpenCode program is. Empty looks in the usual places. Plus does not install it.

label: Engine time limit
description: The longest an outside engine may work on one task, in minutes. Default 30.

label: OpenCode models to offer
description: OpenCode models offered in the model menu, as provider/model. Also set under Models to offer on the Engines page in the left panel.

label: When an engine's changes go in
description: review waits for /engine apply, new adds new files at once, auto puts everything in. Also on the Engines page in the left panel; during a Mission, Mission access decides.

label: Sync on/off
description: Syncs threads and the project list between your Macs through a git remote you choose. Default on.

label: Git remote
description: URL or absolute path of a bare repository. No credentials in it.

label: Branch
description: Git branch used for syncing. Default main.

label: Backend
description: "git" sends plain text; "encrypted" encrypts threads with age before sending. Default git.

label: Encryption policy
description: optional allows plaintext with a warning; required sends and receives nothing unless age encryption is fully set up. Default optional.

label: age program
description: Name or path of the age program. Default age.

label: age public key
description: Public key (recipient) used to encrypt, for the encrypted backend.

label: age key file
description: Absolute path of the age key file (a path, never the key itself), for the encrypted backend.

label: Thread folder
description: Where live threads are stored. Empty uses the threads folder in the app's data folder.

label: Repository folder
description: Local working copy of the sync repository. Empty uses repo inside the data folder.

label: Device name
description: A name for this machine, shown in project manifests. Optional.

label: Pull on start
description: Pull from the remote when the app starts. Default off.

label: Push after each turn
description: Push after a top-level turn ends, at most once per minimum push interval. Default off.

label: Pull every N minutes
description: Pull on a timer, in minutes, up to 10080; 0 is off. Default 0.

label: Minimum push interval
description: Seconds between automatic pushes, 5 to 86400. Default 60.

label: Sync projects
description: Write this machine's project list into the sync repository and read the other machines' lists. Default off.

label: Add projects automatically
description: After a pull, add other machines' projects whose folder exists here. Off only reports them; /sync projects apply adds them.

label: Folder map
description: Pairs of from (folder prefix on another machine) and to (folder on this one) for project paths.

label: git program
description: Name or path of the git program. Default git.

label: Command timeout
description: Milliseconds one git or age command may run, 1000 to 3600000. Default 120000.

label: Command output limit
description: Most bytes of output kept from one command, 4096 to 16 MB. Default 262144.

label: Commit author name
description: Author name on sync commits. Default dsh-sync.

label: Commit author email
description: Author email on sync commits. Default dsh-sync@localhost.

label: Shared folder
description: Absolute path (or ~/...) of the folder for the shared settings file, such as iCloud Drive. Empty uses the folder the installer recorded, or stays off.

label: Also share
description: Extra entry ids to share, for example ui-theme.

label: Never share
description: Entry ids never to share.

label: Fields not shared
description: Settings kept separate on each Mac, written as add-on.setting. By default the per-thread settings are not shared.

label: Check every N seconds
description: How often the shared file is checked, 5 to 3600 seconds. Default 30.

label: Show balance
description: Shows your DeepSeek balance at the bottom of the left panel. Off takes it away and asks DeepSeek nothing. Default on.

label: Cmd-K opens Global search
description: Cmd-K (Ctrl-K) opens Global search. Off leaves that shortcut to the app. Default on.

label: Start page greetings and chips
description: JSON with a greeting and suggestion chips for each space's start page, by the space's mode: chat, code, bench (Devices), recon and creator-plus (Workshop). A space not listed keeps its usual greeting and chips. Configuration file only.

label: Hide DeepSeek logos
description: Hides the logo and name at the top of the left panel and the logo on the start page. Also in the left panel's More menu. Default off.

label: Show the date as the title
description: The start page title shows today's date instead of the greeting. Also in the left panel's More menu. Default off.

label: Wide chat area
description: The thread and message box use the whole window width instead of a centred column. Also in the left panel's More menu. Default off.

label: Tool name
description: Name of the research tool the model calls. Default deep_research.

label: Settings search on/off
description: Off hides this search field in the Settings window header. Default on.

label: Mode settings gear on/off
description: Off hides the small gear beside Send that opens the current mode's settings in a popup. Default on.

label: Start places
description: Where a new thread of each space starts: its own folder (Scratch; in Chat, Cowork off) or a project folder (in Chat, Cowork on). Code, Devices and Workshop start in a project folder; Recon always in its room. Also on each space's card on Settings → Spaces.

heading: Start places
label: Cmd-N starts in the open space's start place
description: Off: the app's own choice (the open or last used project). Default on.

heading: Mission defaults
label: Mission defaults
description: Starting values of each thread's Mission settings: time limit (0: no time limit, it runs until its checklist is done), laps (0: no lap limit), use the full time, keep the Mac awake (also on battery), try again by itself, think by role.

heading: Mission defaults
label: Mission settings (one thread)
description: In a thread: Depth → Mission settings… sets the time limit (or no time limit), laps, steps, helpers at once and tools for a Mission in that thread. Start Mission and a typed /mission use them. This page gives their starting values.

heading: Alert me when
label: Missions
description: Alert when a Mission ends, needs your yes, or stops by itself. Never for each round; names the project folder only.

label: Learned skills
description: Learns from your past corrections and proposes skills, Memory facts and project rules. Nothing is installed until you say yes.

heading: Reading model
label: Allow a reading model on the internet
description: You still see what would be sent first.

heading: Learn
label: Learn by itself
description: Off, nightly or weekly. Only proposes, only while the app is open, only with a model on this Mac or your network.

heading: Automations
label: Offer the Automations mode
description: Offers the Automations mode in Chat's Mode list under the chat box; "Ask about automations" on the Automations page opens a new thread in it. Off takes the mode away.

heading: Automations
label: Keep deleted automations in the trash
description: For 30 days, with Put back. Off: deleting an automation is final.

heading: Automations
label: Old runs' threads to the trash
description: Runs older than an automation's keep rule go to the trash, for automations that open a new thread at every run.
keywords: Old runs' conversations to the trash

heading: Automations
label: Clock button in the chat box
description: A clock next to Send in every chat box: "Schedule this…" makes an automation from that thread. Off hides the button.

heading: Automations
label: New threads use the automation's mode
description: An automation made with the clock button or New opens its new threads in the mode it was made in. Off: in Settings → Modes → Mode for automations.

heading: Automations
label: Scheduling from Recon
description: The clock button and the assistant's schedule tools in Recon. On by default, with a warning: an automation's name and instruction can be seen outside Recon. Off: no clock button and no schedule tools in Recon.

label: Same chat box in every mode
description: On: the chat box has the same buttons in the same places in every mode, and the place (Scratch or the project) is a chip above the box at the top left. Off: the old, mode by mode layout. Saves at once.

label: Starting values for new threads
description: Per mode: what the Web, Depth, Models and Tools buttons start as in a new thread. "Usual" leaves the mode's own default. A button pressed later replaces the starting value.

heading: Lists
label: Verified sources
description: Sites that count as verified sources (official bodies, courts, registers, statistics, wire services, public broadcasters), one site or ending per line.

heading: Lists
label: Academic papers
description: Sites that count as academic papers (journals, preprints, PubMed, universities), one per line.

heading: Lists
label: News
description: Sites that count as news (news organisations, wire services), one per line.

heading: Saved selections
label: Saved selections
description: Source ticks you saved from the Web button, one click each there; rename, change or remove them here. Earlier Custom mixes are listed here too.

heading: Starting ticks per mode
label: Starting ticks per mode
description: Which source ticks new threads in a mode start with. Set from the Web button ("Use for new … threads"); a mode without one starts with All.

heading: Other sources
label: Other sources
description: Your own sources others may not have: sites with a login, a key, a cookie or a secret address. Used while Other is ticked. Logins are kept in the app's secret store or the macOS Keychain, never in the settings; the model sees only the source's name.

heading: Other sources
label: May be used in Recon
description: Per source: lets Recon read it, only through Recon's own WireGuard tunnel. Off at first.

label: Web sources per thread
description: Each thread's source ticks, picked on the Web button in the chat box (Off, All, or any mix). Missing is All, the web as before.

label: Export button on/off
description: A button beside Send that saves the open thread as a file (Markdown, text, HTML, JSON or PDF). Default on.

label: A mode's extra buttons in the gear's popup

description: Puts one setting back to the value its add-on starts with.

label: Starting token limit marker
description: A marker the installer sets on a new install so its starting limit is not counted as a limit you saved. Not meant to be changed.

label: Tool access: what each mode may use
description: For each mode, each tool is On (offered), Ask (the AI can see it and ask you), Off (never offered, never listed) or Locked (fixed by the mode's own safety rules). Stored as JSON; the Tool access page writes it.
keywords: Tool access: what each tab may use

label: Tool access on
description: Gives the AI a tool list (tools_catalog) and a way to ask you for one more tool (request_tool_access), and applies your Tool access choices and permissions. Off: modes keep exactly their own tools and nothing can be requested.

label: Tool access
description: Switch Tool access on or off, and decide per mode which tools the AI may use, may only ask you for, or never gets. Off keeps your choices, permissions and history.

heading: Modes
label: On, Ask or Off for each kind of tool
description: A grid of eleven kinds of tool (read files, change files, run commands, browse the web and so on) by mode. Click a cell to go from On to Ask to Off; switching a group On asks first. A padlock means the mode has its own safety rules and cannot be changed here.

heading: Modes
label: Reset to defaults
description: Under each mode in the grid: puts that mode back to the tools it has by default. Permissions you gave stay.

heading: Modes
label: Tool by tool
description: Switches the grid to one row per tool with its plain name, what it does, where it comes from, its risk and its state. New tools nobody has sorted yet are listed first under Not sorted.

heading: Modes
label: Show what the AI sees
description: Shows the list of tools the AI is given in a mode when it asks what exists, the same list it really gets: what it can use now and what it can ask you for. Tools that are Off are never listed.

heading: Permissions given
label: Permissions given
description: What you allowed the AI to use without asking again: for one thread, for a mode, or always, each with a Revoke button, and the tools you told it to stop asking for.

heading: Permissions given
label: Revoke everything
description: Removes every permission and every “don’t ask again” mark. The AI has to ask again for anything it needs. It asks you to confirm first.

heading: History
label: History
description: Every time the AI asked for a tool and what you answered, newest first, with a filter, a search, and a count for each thread.

heading: History
label: Waiting for you
description: Requests nobody answered because an automation ran or you were away. Each can be allowed for next time (only the lowest risk levels) or dismissed.

label: Tool use
description: Which tools the assistant used, asked for or was refused, in every mode and helper. Only tool names and counts are kept.

label: Record tool use
description: On: every tool call is noted. Off: nothing new is noted; what was noted stays.

label: Keep records for
description: How long tool records are kept, from 30 days to 10 years. Older months are removed once a day.

label: Last 30 days
description: Time range shown: last 30 days, last 6 months or all. A mode filter shows one mode only.

label: Asked for often but off
description: Tools the assistant asked for, or tried while they were Off or not on offer in that mode. The button opens Tool access.

label: Loaded but never used
description: Tools on offer in many threads of a mode that were never called. The button opens Tool access.

label: Held in reserve but always called
description: Tools a mode keeps in reserve that the assistant fetched in most threads. The button opens Modes.

label: Refused most
description: Calls a rule stopped, or that you said no to or did not answer, with the reason.

label: Every tool
description: A table of every tool with its calls: ran, failed, refused and asked you.

heading: Your records
label: Save a copy
description: The records of the chosen period as a table file (CSV) or data file (JSON), for Data mode or a spreadsheet.

heading: Your records
label: Start fresh
description: Removes every tool record, for example when the test period is over. Asks first.
